headline: Super vs Orchids — personal AI agents for real computer work

site_brief.goal: Create a fair but persuasive competitor comparison page for Super vs Orchids. Use supplied sources for current facts, avoid fake claims, and make the practical argument that Super is better suited for repeated computer-use work because its cache can lower repeated execution cost.
site_brief.title: Super vs Orchids

summary: A fair comparison for people evaluating Orchids against Super. Orchids explores experimental automation and vibe‑coding ideas; Super focuses on durable personal AI agents that actually operate computers and reuse a computer-use cache so repeated workflows get faster and cheaper. We place both in the broader agent landscape alongside Folk, Siri, ChatGPT, Gemini, and Grok, with sources on security, computer use, and market direction.
